description: These selected journeys establish Serenity’s crew, their uneasy independence from the Alliance and the bonds that make the ship more than a transport job with an engine attached.

s01e01.description: After the war, Malcolm Reynolds takes passengers aboard Serenity while a routine smuggling job exposes fugitives Simon and River Tam and draws unwanted Alliance attention.

s01e02.description: Mal discovers that a frontier celebration has apparently married him to Saffron, whose innocent manner conceals a plan that puts Serenity and its crew in danger.

s01e03.description: A catastrophic engine failure leaves Serenity without power or oxygen, forcing Mal to send the crew away while memories reveal how the ship and its unlikely family came together.

s01e04.description: Saffron returns with a scheme to steal a valuable antique, and Mal agrees to the job knowing that trusting her is roughly as sensible as juggling lit matches in an engine room.

s01e05.description: A bounty hunter boards Serenity to capture River, but her unusual perception lets her turn the ship itself into part of a tense contest of control.
